text:
### Statement & Communication Address Update  
**Update Delivery Preferences:**  
| Delivery Type | Update Required | Action |
|---|---|---|
| **Physical Statements** | YES | Update mailing address |
| **Bank Statements** | YES | Statements will go to new address |
| **Tax Forms (1099, etc.)** | YES | If international move, may need separate tax address |
| **Correspondence** | YES | All letters to new address |
| **Notice of Change** | YES | Notification letter sent to old address (GDPR) |  
**Email/Phone:**
- [ ] Confirm email address (no change needed unless customer requests)
- [ ] Confirm phone number (no change needed unless customer requests)
- [ ] Update contact method preference (email vs. post)
name: Chunk 34/52

raw_entities.name: Statement and Communication Address Update
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for updating a customer's mailing address and delivery preferences for statements, tax forms, and correspondence. The process includes updating physical statement delivery, bank statement routing, tax form addresses, and general correspondence, with mandatory GDPR notification to the old address. Email and phone contact preferences are confirmed but only updated upon customer request.
context: Update mailing address
Statements will go to new address
All letters to new address
Notification letter sent to old address (GDPR)

raw_entities.name: Update Physical Statements Mailing Address
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to update the mailing address for physical bank statements. This ensures future statements are delivered to the customer's new address.
context: Physical Statements | YES | Update mailing address

raw_entities.name: Route Bank Statements to New Address
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to ensure all bank statements are routed to the customer's new address following the address change.
context: Bank Statements | YES | Statements will go to new address

raw_entities.name: Update Tax Form Address
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to update the address for tax forms (1099, etc.). For international moves, a separate tax address may be required due to regulatory requirements.
context: Tax Forms (1099, etc.) | YES | If international move, may need separate tax address

raw_entities.name: Update Correspondence Address
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to ensure all letters and general correspondence from the bank are sent to the customer's new address.
context: Correspondence | YES | All letters to new address

raw_entities.name: Send Notice of Change to Old Address
raw_entities.description: Mandatory GDPR-compliant step to notify the customer at their old address that their address has been changed. This provides transparency and allows the customer to verify the change or report unauthorized modifications.
context: Notice of Change | YES | Notification letter sent to old address (GDPR)

raw_entities.name: Confirm Email Address
raw_entities.description: Optional step to confirm the customer's email address. No change is required unless the customer explicitly requests an email address update.
context: Confirm email address (no change needed unless customer requests)

raw_entities.name: Confirm Phone Number
raw_entities.description: Optional step to confirm the customer's phone number. No change is required unless the customer explicitly requests a phone number update.
context: Confirm phone number (no change needed unless customer requests)

raw_entities.name: Update Contact Method Preference
raw_entities.description: Optional step to update the customer's preferred contact method, allowing them to choose between email and postal communication for future correspondence.
context: Update contact method preference (email vs. post)

raw_entities.name: New Mailing Address
raw_entities.description: The customer's new mailing address to which all statements, tax forms, and correspondence will be delivered following the address change process.
context: Update mailing address
Statements will go to new address
All letters to new address

raw_entities.name: Old Mailing Address
raw_entities.description: The customer's previous mailing address to which the GDPR-compliant Notice of Change notification is sent to inform them of the address update.
context: Notification letter sent to old address (GDPR)

raw_entities.name: Tax Form
raw_entities.description: Tax forms (such as 1099) that require address updates as part of the statement and communication address change process. For international moves, a separate tax address may be required.
context: Tax Forms (1099, etc.) | YES | If international move, may need separate tax address

raw_entities.name: GDPR Notification Compliance
raw_entities.description: Mandatory GDPR compliance gate requiring notification to the customer's old address when their address is updated. This ensures transparency and allows the customer to verify or dispute the change.
context: Notification letter sent to old address (GDPR)
